title: Austin F1, Development Fees, & Airport Blvd
summary:
*   A debate over increasing building permit fees revealed concerns from developers about transparency and fairness (vertical vs. horizontal development), despite supporting the goal of faster permit processing through more staff.
*   Extensive preparations for the 2012 Formula One Grand Prix were detailed, covering comprehensive traffic and public safety plans, a temporary international terminal at the airport, and strategies for managing the anticipated 300,000 visitors.
*   Plans for transforming Airport Boulevard were presented, introducing a "form-based code" to create a more walkable, mixed-use corridor, support local businesses, and address housing needs with sustainable development and thoughtful transitions to nearby neighborhoods.
